law: Spawn @racalvin/grudge-warlords main is the source of truth for how the game plays. ObjectStore api/v1 is the published catalog: definitions are edited here, checked against the Spawn pin, then served from info/objectstore. Binaries only from assets.grudge-studio.com. Player state only from grudge-api (Railway) keyed by grudgeId.

readers.legion: Fetch this manifest, then the files it lists. Ground answers on them (retrieval), cite uuid, and call the player API for anything about a player. Do not fine-tune canon into a model; canon changes weekly.
readers.games: Read definitions by uuid. Never copy a catalog into a client bundle without its sha256 from here.

idFamilies.player: grudgeId GRUDGE_* (grudge-api). The only cross-service player key.
idFamilies.character: characters.id RFC UUID (grudge-api). GRDG-* is a display stamp, not a key.
idFamilies.itemInstance: grudge_uuid minted by the server ledger only.
idFamilies.itemDefinition: ITEM-*/FOOD-*/POTN-*/CONS-* in master-items.json. Frozen: existing ids are never re-minted, even though they are timestamp-based.
idFamilies.asset: grudgeUuid = sha1("grudge-asset:{r2Key}") laid out as a v5-style UUID; ICON-* uses the same seed

eras.stats: STR VIT DEX INT TAC (8 attrs in master-attributes)
BIO NEU KIN QNT SYN CHR ENT GRA — live GET https://grudges.grudge-studio.com/api/stats/primary
Same Nexus BIO…GRA when playing Grudges

glossary.means: A product era (warlords, nexus, voxel, armada, plus shared for assets). Not a period of in-world history; use "age" for that. No ages are canon yet.
In-world faction id legion: orcs and undead, patron Madra.
The studio AI service at ai.grudge-studio.com (service id legion-ai). Never the faction.
A player account key, GRUDGE_ plus 20 characters total.
A deterministic definition or asset id. Never a player.
Three things share the name: the GRUDACHAIN ESP32 node, the Legion persona grd17, and grd17CompressionService. In canon it only ever means the compression format for stored JSON.

compression: Large canon files may be stored at rest as GRD-17 brotli with the algorithm in R2 customMetadata. HTTP responses rely on Cloudflare compression; sha256 here is of the uncompressed JSON.

knownDivergences.canon: ObjectStore api/v1/races.json bonuses on the 0.1 to 0.4 scale (for example human +0.1 to all, orc +0.4 Strength)
knownDivergences.fix: Spawn: replace RACES.*.bonuses and passive with races.json values. Needs Jonathan's "push" for Spawn main; then refresh spawnPin.
